_source: Git-tracked fallback for curia-research-daily and curia-suggestion-review's daily briefing (see docs/data/pending-review-queue.json's own note for the full diagnosis — the Artifact tool's write_db is unreachable from this job's headless execution environment, read_db is fine). Each run appends one entry here instead of writing directly to Curia Command's `briefings` collection; synced in from a human or an interactive session during a normal check-in. `synced` flips to true once it's landed in the portal.

entries.title: 8 venues + Chester (new Cheshire district) promoted; 1 rejected as a real chain, 1 naming mix-up sent for review
entries.summary: Independently re-verified all 10 pending candidates in venue-suggestions.json with a 2026-09-16 suggestedDate and the sole pending district candidate (Chester), promoting 8 venues (Pottery Corner, Chorlton; The Damson Tree Cafe, Cheadle Hulme; Ebenezer's Craft Beer Emporium, Nantwich; St Peter's Church & Norman Chapel, Prestbury; BeefnBerry Bistro, Macclesfield; The Blarney Barrel, Bramhall; The Old Bakery Didsbury; Runway Pilates, Alderley Edge) and Chester itself. Mouro Coffee Bar (Heaton Moor) was rejected, reversing the original researcher's own finding — fresh search found it's actually a real, actively expanding four-site coffee brand (Heaton Moor plus two Altrincham sites plus a fourth opened May 2026 in the Northern Quarter), past this file's small-sibling-group allowance. Underbank (Stockport (Underbanks)) needed a genuine human call rather than a promote/reject guess: it appears to describe the same real venue as this file's own already-promoted 'The Underbank' entry, while a separate, different venue with a near-identical name (Benji Taylor's live-music venue) seems to be the one that name actually belongs to — a naming mix-up, sent to pending-review-queue.json. Curia Command's pending_review collection (checked via read_db) had zero decided items to apply this run. Prana, Buon Cibo and Rustik remain unchanged in pending-review-queue.json, still awaiting a human decision. The closure-audit rotating slice (Manchester Craft and Design Centre, The Horsfall, Bar Etna, Knutcraft at the Ruskin Rooms, Mobberley Ice Cream Coffee House) found no closures — all five re-confirmed still trading.

entries.summary: Of 15 pending entries in venue-suggestions.json, 9 already had a live, undecided pending-review-queue.json entry from a 2026-10-24/26/27/28/30 run and were left untouched. The remaining 6, all suggested 2026-10-31, were independently re-verified fresh and promoted: Flute & Firkin (Poynton) — CAMRA's own 'Independent Pub' tag and a March 2026-dated listing confirm current trading, no second site found; Poynton Park and Pool (Poynton) — a genuine council-run public park, Hard rule 1 not applicable; Poynton Tea Room (Poynton) and Main Street Kitchen (Frodsham) — thinner web footprints than this run's other candidates (no official site, a couple of consistent directory listings each) but no closure or chain signal found on fresh search, read as light-footprint real businesses rather than genuine conflicts; Bollington Arts Centre (Wellington Road) — a dated Oct 2026 ticketed show and the 2026 Bollington Festival's own listings confirm current operation; Lady Heyes Crafts and Antique Centre (Frodsham) — a single multi-seller site, not a chain, with a Sept 2026 mention and current council notices confirming it's still trading. No chain-footprint, duplicate, or closure concern found for any of the six. Curia Command's pending_review collection was checked (db_query, read-only) and had zero decided items to apply. district-suggestions.json had zero actionable pending entries. The closure-audit rotating slice (Tango Champagne & Cocktail Bar, CIELLE Restaurant & Bar, V Lounge Cafe & Cocktail Bar, 1500 BC Wine Bar — all Fira — and Sun Spirit Cocktail Bar, Oia) found no closure signal for any of the five; one aggregator flags Tango as 'Temporarily Closed', consistent with its own documented Nov-April seasonal off-season rather than a permanent closure.
